item.title: DOJ seeks to block Alaska Senate certification if Sullivan loses
item.description: The Justice Department asks a federal court to block certification if Sen. Sullivan loses, though he would have won if the other Sullivan's votes were counted.

item.title: Watchdog: DOJ dropped school discrimination cases without ensuring compliance
item.description: A watchdog found the Justice Department backed dismissals in at least 18 cases without first asking the overseeing federal court to determine if schools had ended discrimination.

item.title: DOJ sues preemptively to block Alaska Senate certification if Republican loses narrowly
item.description: The Trump administration filed a preemptive lawsuit to block certification of the Alaska Senate race, citing name confusion among candidates.
